subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text mirroring extend the existing `voice.agentSession` target design, add a per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`, or remain unsupported for now?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent config shape and delivery semantics affect public Discord voice configuration and overlap an existing shipped routing surface.

options.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` with mirroring semantics
options.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical bridge and add explicit opt-in transcript/reply delivery behavior there.

options.title: Accept per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`
options.body: Support fixed-room voice/text pairs directly on autoJoin entries, at the cost of a second routing concept beside `voice.agentSession`.

options.title: Do not add automatic mirroring
options.body: Keep `voice.agentSession` as session routing only and require agents or tools to post Discord text explicitly when desired.

recommendation.title: Extend `voice.agentSession` with mirroring semantics
recommendation.body: Use the existing target-session surface as the canonical bridge and add explicit opt-in transcript/reply delivery behavior there.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent issue review and adjacent Discord voice changes make this the strongest available owner for the product-direction call.
